name: strike-region-scores
notes: ADR-0270 execution path decision (2026-10-18): the strike-level assessment of the screen's CDFExperiment fits, a tier-3 child node over existing owners, no dskit change and no fit. It reloads every (fold, arm, candidate) cell of one CDFExperiment output root, verifies each artifact against the cell identity it recomputes (AtomicFitStore), rebuilds the fit and validation bands through the experiment's own methods, restores the TorchCDF checkpoint, and scores BOTH bands: the model mixture, the per-symbol horizon_empirical baseline refit from that fold's fit rows, and the pooled standardized empirical (one HorizonEmpiricalCDF per fold on all admitted symbols' fit rows) and the market-implied curve from the panel's rn_q quantiles (raw: the transported variant stays with the market stage), each with CRPS, tail CRPS, PIT, threshold Brier at the protocol's strike_grid_z, the 14 region masses against the realized region, per-threshold reliability (mean F(z) against the realized frequency of y <= z), sharpness, and the decision strike Brier and wing twCRPS at the row's listed strikes (valid-quote strikes of the chain archive, equal weight, z = log(K / spot) / reference_scale with the spot from the panel). Cells follow strike-screen-protocol.json (cells.dte_slices x 14 regions x ticker group, per window, per sub-period and per year) with paired differences model-market, model-baseline and market-baseline, support, and standard errors clustered by symbol and by settlement date (the wider is reported; two-way clustering is a documented gap). curves.json carries the per-epoch losses by seed and the no-learning and overfit signatures (rules inside). One document per experiment document: copy it and change experiment_document and output for each loss (L1, L3). PLACEHOLDERS: every path below is under the pilot root and is filled when the fits are registered; manifest_sha256 pins are zero until the converter outputs are onboarded; ticker_groups is empty until the fit-band liquidity terciles are registered (then it maps each symbol to a group name, and cells are also reported per group). Run from children/index_options: python -m dskit.pipeline run configs/run-strike-region-scores.json --asof 2023-12-31. Reads only rows before end_before (the sealed holdout, 2024 onward, is never read: end_before may not be earlier than the experiment document's own read bounds, and the owner's reader applies those bounds as it reads, so nothing at or after it is decoded) and writes nothing outside the new output directory.

outputs.notes: The pipeline run directory (run report and fingerprints); the score tables go to the node's output. Excluded from the identity hash.

scores.notes: z_grid, dte_slices and sub_periods are the protocol's strike_grid_z, cells.dte_slices and windows.validation.sub_periods (a test pins them); the grid gives 12 inner 0.5-wide bins and two tails. market: the 19 proxy probabilities of the arms document (raw_chain.proxy_probabilities), the panel's rn_q_<pppp> columns already standardized by the reference scale (units z), completed by a 4-wide linear tail (the OptionImpliedTransportCDF default) beyond the outermost quantiles: the two tail regions' market masses depend on that completion. listed_strikes: the converter's chain archive (archive_relpath layout) through the onboarding store, strikes with bid > 0 and ask >= bid on either side, at least two. fit_band_sample bounds the fit-band rows scored per cell by a deterministic stride (the whole validation band is always scored); chunk_rows bounds memory; stored_tolerance is how closely the re-scored validation CRPS must reproduce the shards the queue stored (a larger gap is an integrity error). end_before is the protocol's screen holdout_start and must not be earlier than the experiment document's own read bounds, so no panel row at or after it is decoded. The validation rows must also reproduce the stored mixture parameters (1e-6) and CRPS.
